svg.aria-label: Three questions that locate the line between automation and an agent: can you enumerate the branches, does the next step depend on content or only on success, and can a wrong step be undone.
svg.text: Three questions that locate the line
Answer these before anyone opens a tool. Two of three pointing to automation is the common result.
If you can enumerate them, even twenty of them, that is a flowchart and it is automation.
Twenty branches you can name beats a loop you cannot inspect.
If the next step depends on whether the last one worked, that is a conditional. Automation.
If it depends on what the last step returned, you have a genuine case. This question decides it.
Can a wrong step be undone?
If not, you need a checkpoint. A mandatory checkpoint spends most of what the autonomy was for.
Irreversible plus autonomous is the combination that produces expensive incidents.
Two of three pointing at automation and you should build automation, whatever the brief said it was.
the word in the request is not evidence about the shape of the work
